Scientific Instruments Change - Shipping Safety Control Zone 11 - Coronation Gulf
Subsurface scientific mooring deployed in 68 23.750N 109 59.540W, depth of sea floor 236m. Mooring extends 2m from the sea floor. Mooring to be remaining in place for a full year.
